a261021p1.summary: NextDC plunge adds to sector woes as Nvidia holds talks over injecting capital into Firmus after failed IPO
a261021p1.title: NextDC's stock fell as much as 44% to A$5.15 after the Australian data center company cut its earnings forecast by over a third; shares were above A$16 in June (Nic Fildes/Financial Times)
